app.title: Save Email as Image
app.subtitle: Export this message as PNG or JPG
info.sentTimeReceived: Sent time unavailable — showing receive time
error.noItem: No email is currently selected. Open or select a message to continue.
error.bodyEmpty: This email has no readable body content.
error.bodyUnreadable: Could not read the email body. The message may be encrypted (IRM/S/MIME), still loading, or otherwise inaccessible.
error.officeInit: Could not connect to Outlook. The add-in did not finish loading. Close and reopen the task pane, or restart Outlook and try again.
error.renderFailed: Rendering failed. Try a smaller width or scale.
error.tooManyImages: This email contains too many inline images to render reliably.
error.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is not available in this Outlook environment. Save the image and copy it manually instead.
error.clipboardBlocked: Your browser blocked clipboard access for this add-in. This is a known Outlook-on-the-web restriction — use Save instead, or try the Outlook desktop app where copy works.
error.clipboardPngOnly: Clipboard supports PNG only. Switch the format to PNG to copy.
